summary: Unexpected observability retention surcharge charged to trial org after account consolidation
description:
Issue summary:
Customer reports an unexpected line item on their finalized invoice labeled 'Observability retention overage (surcharge)'. DataForge Labs is a trial org that purchased the observability retention add-on during onboarding (subscription ID: SUB-T-9987). They claim the add-on should have covered the bytes retained during the billing window.

Impact:
- Customer is on a trial / self-serve plan and was not expecting any charges; finance flagged the charge and paused onboarding.
- Onboarding flow is blocked until credit is resolved; customer is requesting provisional reversal so their SRE can continue validation.

Environment:
- Org: DataForge Labs (org-123-dfl)
- Plan: trial with Observability Retention add-on purchased on 2026-02-25
- Deployment: hosted Redwood API, us-west-2 region, console displays entitlement on 2026-02-26

Steps to reproduce / evidence provided by customer:
1) Customer uploaded screenshot of console entitlement page showing "Observability retention: 90 days" for org-123-dfl (screenshot attached in ticket).
2) Customer exported Console -> Billing -> Retention Usage CSV showing daily retained bytes between 2026-03-01 and 2026-03-12.
3) Finalized invoice INV-2026-03-1147 dated 2026-03-13 contains line item: "Observability retention overage — $1,200.00" and references tag: retention:premium_v2.
4) Customer points to a recent org consolidation performed on 2026-03-02 (merging sandbox subaccount into org-123-dfl) and suspects tag normalization during merge changed addon entitlement tag.

Logs / links provided by customer:
- Console screenshot: (attached)
- Retention usage CSV: (attached)
- Invoice PDF: (attached)
- Slack thread: https://redwood.slack.com/archives/C01234ABC/p1677777000000

Customer request:
- Provide per-day byte accounting against entitlement for billing period, including which internal tag was used to match entitlements to usage.
- Reconcile why entitlement was not applied (or why usage matched to a different tag) and whether this was caused by the org-consolidation script that ran 2026-03-02.
- Apply provisional credit for the $1,200 pending root-cause investigation and permanent resolution.

Notes on urgency: customer onboarding blocked; requested provisional credit and final explanation before 2026-03-16 (end of week).
comments: 2026-03-14 09:12 - Maya Chen (reporter): Opened ticket after customer emailed billing@redwood. Provided invoice and CSV. Asked for provisional reversal and per-day accounting.
2026-03-14 11:37 - Billing Agent (Ruth Alvarez): Acknowledged receipt; asked for entitlement purchase record and subscription id. Asked engineering for quick look at entitlement mapping logs.

2026-03-14 13:02 - Customer (DataForge Labs - Jordan Miles): Confirmed subscription id SUB-T-9987 and attached purchase confirmation. Stated consolidation script merged sandbox:sub-88 -> org-123-dfl on 2026-03-02 at 02:11 UTC.
2026-03-14 15:30 - Arjun Patel (assignee): Requested retention-postback audit logs from Reconciler team and tag normalization history; filed INT-448002 to request runbook for org-merge.
investigation_notes:
Initial triage (2026-03-14):
- Billing lookup shows entitlement SUB-T-9987 active and bound to org-123-dfl as of 2026-02-26.
- Invoice line references internal rate key retention:premium_v2. Entitlement registry shows grant under retention:legacy_90d.
- Hypothesis: org-consolidation job normalized or remapped retention tags from 'legacy_90d' to 'retention:premium_v2' after 2026-03-02; matching algorithm in postback-reconciler uses exact tag equality and did not accept legacy tag, causing usage to be considered 'unentitled' and billed as overage.
- Action items: (1) request postback logs for retention usage for 2026-03-01..2026-03-12 from Reconciler (postback ids); (2) check entitlement-change events from entitlement service around 2026-03-02; (3) verify whether migration script wrote a tag alias map into entitlement registry.
- Quick mitigation: Billing can apply provisional credit pending verification. Recommend provisional credit equal to disputed amount to unblock customer.
requested_resolution: 1) Provide CSV mapping of daily retained bytes vs entitlement for billing window. 2) If tag normalization error caused misattribution, reverse the invoice line and credit $1,200. 3) Fix entitlement mapping so future merges keep alias mapping. 4) Confirm by 2026-03-16.
workaround: Customer can pause observability retention export from their app to avoid further accruals; billing provisional credit requested to unblock onboarding.
follow_up_tasks: Add integration test for org-merge tag mapping
Apply provisional credit to INV-2026-03-1147 if reconciliation confirms migration bug
